requirements.text: Given a city name is entered and submitted, a list of matching Location results is shown (AC-1).
test_refs: geocodingClient.test.ts::returns matching Location results for a valid query
useLocationSearch.test.ts::shows results for a valid query (AC-1)
LocationSearch.test.tsx::shows results with disambiguation for a valid query (AC-1, AC-2)

requirements.text: When a query matches Locations in more than one country, each result shows disambiguating region/country info (AC-2).
test_refs: geocodingClient.test.ts::includes disambiguating region/country info when multiple countries match
LocationResultsList.test.tsx::shows disambiguating region/country info for each result (AC-2, AC-7)

requirements.text: When the user selects one Location, it becomes the active Location (AC-3).
test_refs: ActiveLocationContext.test.tsx::makes the selected Location the active Location (AC-3)
LocationResultsList.test.tsx::calls onSelect with the chosen Location when clicked (AC-3)
LocationSearch.test.tsx::makes the selected result the active Location (AC-3)
requirements.notes: Scoped per human decision 2026-07-27: WEATHER-2 sets the active Location in shared state only; the current-conditions fetch/display for that Location is WEATHER-3's component (declared dependency), not duplicated here.

requirements.text: When a query matches no Location, a clear "no results" message is shown, not an error page (AC-4).
test_refs: geocodingClient.test.ts::returns an empty array when no Location matches the query
useLocationSearch.test.ts::shows no-results when the Weather Provider finds nothing (AC-4)
LocationSearch.test.tsx::shows a no-results message for a query with no matches (AC-4)

requirements.text: When the Weather Provider is unreachable and the search request fails, a distinct error message is shown with a retry option (AC-5).
test_refs: geocodingClient.test.ts::throws WeatherProviderUnreachableError when the network request fails
geocodingClient.test.ts::throws WeatherProviderUnreachableError when the provider returns a non-OK response
useLocationSearch.test.ts::shows error on Weather Provider failure and recovers via retry (AC-5)
LocationSearch.test.tsx::shows an error with retry, and recovers when retried (AC-5)

requirements.text: When the query is blank or under 2 characters and submitted, a "query too short" message is shown and no search runs (AC-6).
test_refs: validateQuery.test.ts::is invalid for an empty query
validateQuery.test.ts::is invalid for a query under 2 characters
validateQuery.test.ts::treats a whitespace-only query as too short
useLocationSearch.test.ts::shows too-short without calling the Weather Provider (AC-6)
LocationSearch.test.tsx::shows a too-short message and does not call the Weather Provider (AC-6)

requirements.text: When a query matches Locations in multiple countries worldwide, all matches are returned regardless of country (AC-7).
test_refs: geocodingClient.test.ts::returns matches across multiple countries worldwide without filtering to one
